patterns.note: Extremely sparse layout with vast amounts of whitespace, emphasizing individual content blocks and large section titles, creating a breathable and premium feel.
Dominant use of oversized, thin sans-serif typography for main section headings, creating a strong visual anchor and hierarchy against smaller, regular-weight body text and tiny uppercase labels.
Monochromatic color scheme primarily using white and light grey backgrounds with dark grey text, creating a clean, minimalist, and high-tech aesthetic.
Large, fixed section titles (e.g., 'Gear', 'Solutions') remain in place or scroll very slowly, creating a parallax effect as subsequent content sections scroll over them.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections introduced by oversized headings, with internal content often presented in a two-column split (text left, image/details right).

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport. Main section headings are implemented with a fixed or slow-scrolling position, allowing subsequent content blocks to scroll over them, creating a layered parallax effect. Content within each section, such as images and descriptive text, appears to fade or slide into view as the user scrolls, utilizing scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations. The initial hero features a large, faint background logo that likely animates out or fades on initial scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif body text and tiny uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy, with vast vertical and horizontal whitespace between elements and sections, creating a sense of luxury and minimalism.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the extreme sparsity and the dramatic scale of the typography, particularly the oversized, thin section headings that create a strong visual anchor and a unique parallax effect as content scrolls over them. This, combined with the vast whitespace, gives the site a highly refined and almost architectural feel.
